verbatim_owner_scope: 它取代「album reopen 與 ellipsis 必須分成兩個不同 Codex 回合」的做法，原因是 live evidence 已重複證明：attempt-17 結束時 album-detail 已正確開啟，但 attempt-18 開始前 LINE 又自行回到 album-list。
因此本次授權允許在「同一個 uninterrupted attempt」內，依 fresh current state 條件式完成：album-list → 最多一次 album-card reopening click → composite verification → 最多一次 ellipsis click → menu observation → STOP
album_card_click <= 1 / ellipsis_click <= 1 / 最大總 GUI input <= 2
album-card click 只有在 fresh current state = verified album-list 且 frozen v6 = ELIGIBLE 時才可用。
ellipsis click 只有在 fresh current state 已經得到 ALBUM_OPEN_VERIFIED_COMPOSITE 且 frozen v5 = ELIGIBLE 時才可用。
任何一個 GUI dispatch 發生後，其 budget 永久消費。不得因 failure 再點一次。
attempt-18 未消費的 ellipsis budget 不得移轉。本授權是一個全新的 authorization。

gate_a_baseline_from_owner.owner_note: 不要把 prompt 中 origin/master 的手抄 SHA 當真；由 disk 唯讀取得完整值。HEAD 不符 2d93e881 時僅在可由 owner-authorized append-only evidence commits 完整解釋時才可繼續，否則 STOP。

decision_matrix.S1_A_album_list: fresh binding -> frozen v6 (must be ELIGIBLE) -> exactly one album-card click -> fresh post-click composite verification -> if PASS continue IN THE SAME ROUND to ellipsis gate; do not end the round
decision_matrix.S1_B_detail_candidate: album_card_used = 0; no card click; fresh binding + composite directly; if composite FAIL STOP and NEVER fall back to clicking a card as repair
decision_matrix.composite_pass_v5_not_eligible: STOP, ellipsis 0, no v4 fallback / no threshold change / no retry
decision_matrix.menu_affirmative_with_save_all_identifie: READY_FOR_SAVE_ALL_GATE_A_AUTHORIZATION with Save All still 0, then STOP

hard_rule_false_positive.statement: frozen verifier ALBUM_OPEN_VERIFIED 永遠不能單獨授權 v5 或 ellipsis；必須有同一 current evidence chain 的 v7 = ALBUM_DETAIL_WINDOW_LINEAGE_VERIFIED（ALBUM_OPEN_VERIFIED_COMPOSITE）。
